report: Hydraulic hose burst on the implement lift. Oil on the ground. Mechanic is on site with a spare hose.
lesson: Keep a spare implement-lift hose and a mechanic dispatch ready for hydraulic bursts, since a swap on site is the fastest repair and oil cleanup adds time.

report: Hydraulic hose burst on the implement lift. Oil on the ground. Mechanic is on site with a spare hose.
lesson: This fault took 35 min to repair. The estimate was 40 min.

report: Engine overheat warning, coolant temperature in the red. Radiator screen is packed with chaff.
lesson: When a tractor overheats with a packed radiator screen, clear the chaff and let the engine cool before restarting, and check the screen at the start of each shift.

report: Engine overheat warning, coolant temperature in the red. Radiator screen is packed with chaff.
lesson: This fault took 20 min to repair. The estimate was 45 min.

report: Rear tyre punctured by a steel post, tyre is flat. Service truck is about 40 minutes away.
lesson: A punctured tyre from a steel post is a field repair that depends on the service truck's arrival, so record the actual repair time to calibrate future estimates.

report: Rear tyre punctured by a steel post, tyre is flat. Service truck is about 40 minutes away.
lesson: This fault took 90 min to repair. The estimate was 85 min.

report: GPS receiver lost its RTK fix and will not reacquire. Auto-steer has disengaged.
lesson: No past lesson exists for RTK fix loss, so record the measured repair time for the next GPS receiver reacquisition fault.

report: GPS receiver lost its RTK fix and will not reacquire. Auto-steer has disengaged.
lesson: This fault took 15 min to repair. The estimate was 60 min.

report: PTO shaft sheared at the universal joint. A replacement has to come from the dealer in town.
lesson: Keep a spare PTO shaft or universal joint on hand, since a dealer trip makes a sheared PTO shaft repair take hours instead of minutes.

report: PTO shaft sheared at the universal joint. A replacement has to come from the dealer in town.
lesson: This fault took 240 min to repair. The estimate was 150 min.

report: Low DEF warning, then the engine derated to idle. The DEF tank is empty.
lesson: Low DEF warnings escalate to engine derate, so refill DEF when the low warning first appears, before the tank runs empty.

report: Low DEF warning, then the engine derated to idle. The DEF tank is empty.
lesson: This fault took 25 min to repair. The estimate was 45 min.

report: Alternator belt snapped, battery light is on. A spare belt is in the yard.
lesson: When an alternator belt snaps, keep a spare belt on the tractor or in the yard and stop the tractor before the battery drains, because a running engine with no charging can leave it stranded.

report: Alternator belt snapped, battery light is on. A spare belt is in the yard.
lesson: This fault took 45 min to repair. The estimate was 45 min.
